20150104.text: ...I have put out the order to seize all Delusions.

20150105.text: The vast majority are showing some loss of vitality, but nothing serious.

20150106.text: Sadly, a few have been... less fortunate...

20150107.text: Your Excellency, I'm planning to establish a dedicated field hospital to monitor their condition.

20150108.text: The soldiers are up in arms about the ban though. They know full well what a Delusion is, but they still intend to keep using them.

20150109.text: Okay. I'll leave you to deal with this situation. I have to get to the front line.

20150110.text: This whole fiasco is certain to be a blow to morale. If the Shogun's Army attacks now, while we're scrambling to recover, it could well undo everything we have achieved so far.

20150112.text: I'll go confront the Fatui directly.

20150114.text: The Sakoku Decree is still in force, so their Delusions must be produced within Inazuma's borders.

20150115.text: To organize an operation of this scale, they will have had to mobilize a huge amount of manpower and resources. They can't have done it without local support.

20150116.text: If we want to stop them, we have to destroy the factory where the Delusions are made. But it's sure to be heavily guarded...

20150117.text: It's dangerous to go alone. At least take some troops with you...

20150119.text: Your Excellency, given the urgency of the situation, we were hardly discreet when confiscating the Delusions. The Fatui are sure to take notice.

20150120.text: If we spend any longer amassing our forces, they will get wind of our plans and make their escape.

20150121.text: Very true. Mm... let me think...

20150122.text: I gave this some thought while you were confiscating the Delusions. The site of the factory must be big and secluded, but close enough to a transport route to ensure the supply of raw materials...

20150123.text: Not many places meet these criteria, and if we take the locations where our soldiers received their Delusions into account as well, I suspect the site is likely to be the cliffs near the ocean at the southwest of <color=#00E1FFFF>Yashiori Island</color>.

20150124.text: I'm not going to stop you, but please be careful.

20150125.text: We have lost too many courageous fighters already. I don't want to lose you too.

20150127.text: Huh? You mean, to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Delusion factory</color>?

20150129.text: Really? You aren't going to think it over first? Ugh, fine...

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for the place where the Delusions are being made
Look for the person running the factory

20150401.text: You actually managed to find this place. Congratulations.

20150402.text: Hah. Barely two words in and you already look like you want me dead.

20150405.text: Oh, so that's what this is about.

20150406.text: I think you've got the wrong idea. I know how this looks, but I'm just here to follow orders.

20150407.text: I'm obviously not the mastermind behind this. Aren't you supposed to be pretty tough? What are you waiting for, go get them.

20150408.text: You're getting all worked up over nothing. Pff, you've changed... You're getting weak.

20150409.text: How can you say this is nothing?

20150410.text: How can you call it anything more? It's the way of the world. Human life is worthless.

20150411.text: They were always going to die, with or without a Delusion. At least having one gives them a chance to fulfill their ambitions.

20150412.text: Do you have any idea how useful the Vision Hunt Decree is to us? It took a lot of work to make it happen. Obviously it was in our best interests.

20150413.text: Good news is, our hard work is finally paying off. Generating conflict creates a big market for Delusions. Now we just let the promise of power draw in the weak...

20150414.text: For just a small price, they get the feeling of controlling the world. Trading their life for supreme power... pretty good deal, don't you think?

20150415.text: So the Fatui started the Vision Hunt Decree? You've been behind it all along?

20150416.text: From the outside, Inazuma looks pretty impenetrable, but on the inside... it's a land of opportunity. With a little effort, we were able to break them down from within.

20150417.text: Eternity stretches things out over a long time. But each moment within it becomes all the more fragile.

20150418.text: Take your friend in the resistance, for example. There's nothing you can do now. He's a lost cause.

20150419.text: Just like a bubble on the water. Beautiful for a moment, then total destruction.

20150420.text: The more it takes from them, the more tightly they hold onto it. And the more incompetent they are, the more determined they are to fight it! Hahaha, it's such a farce, you have to see the funny side.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the person running the factory

20150502.text: So you're another Fatui Harbinger... like Signora and Childe?

20150503.text: Signora and Childe? Huh... I didn't know you and my two least reliable colleagues were acquainted.

20150504.text: I'm The Balladeer, No. 6 of the Fatui Harbingers. Delighted to meet you, O Mighty Traveler.

20150505.text: So many visitors today. To what do I owe the honor?

20155201.text: Teppei's breathing is getting weaker and weaker...

20155325.text: The situation of the Inazuman civil war is presently uncertain. The longer this conflict drags on, the more advantageous our position will be...

20155326.text: To deepen the resistance's reliance on Delusions, to fan the flames of war, and steel the resolve of the leadership on both sides to continue fighting...

20155327.text: I call upon all available comrades to assist the work of 2nd Naval Lieutenant Nathan in dashing Sangonomiya's hopes for a quick victory...

20155328.text: If there are any accidents, assist in 2nd Lieutenant Nathan's escape, and silence all who might reveal our infiltration into their ranks!

20155329.text: This mission is of vital importance to securing our supply of Delusions — not a single detail may be overlooked!
